name: GoodTime
description:
The GoodTime connector lets Claude work directly with your GoodTime interview scheduling data. Look up candidates and contacts, review upcoming and past interviews, check interview statuses, and manage interviewer tags and tag types — all from a conversation.
Use it to answer questions like "what interviews are scheduled this week?", find candidates by name or email, audit interviewer pools by tag, or update interviewer and tag information without leaving Claude. The connector supports both read and write operations: it can retrieve scheduling data and make updates to interviewers and tags on your behalf.
GoodTime is the interview scheduling platform trusted by talent teams at high-volume hiring organizations to automate recruiting coordination.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoodTime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoodTime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.service.goodtime.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoodTime MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoodTime lists 18 MCP tools, including add_contact_tags, create_tag, create_tag_type, get_contact_tags, get_interview, get_tag, get_tag_type, list_contacts, list_interviews, list_tag_types, list_tags, and list_tags_by_type.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoodTime?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoodTime in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GoodTime requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GoodTime is developed by GoodTime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
